column1: What CSS property enables native container-level scroll snapping along the horizontal axis?
column2: scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;

column1: What is the difference between scroll-snap-type: x mandatory and scroll-snap-type: x proximity?
column2: mandatory forces the viewport to snap to a point immediately after scrolling stops, while proximity snaps only if the scroll position is near a snap point.

column1: What CSS property defines how an individual child element aligns inside a scroll-snap container?
column2: scroll-snap-align: center; (or start, end)

column1: How do negative margins combined with matching horizontal padding create an edge-to-edge bleed scroll rail?
column2: margin-left: -16px; margin-right: -16px; padding: 0 16px; allows cards to scroll flush to screen edges while preserving container alignment.

column1: What viewport-relative CSS width formula creates a 15% card peek affordance on mobile screens?
column2: flex: 0 0 calc(85vw - 16px);

column1: Why is visual card peeking critical for horizontal scroll tracks on mobile?
column2: It provides a visual affordance that more content exists horizontally, eliminating the need for complex tutorial animations.

column1: What CSS property enables hardware-accelerated momentum scrolling on iOS WebKit devices?
column2: -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;

column1: What CSS properties customize scrollbar appearance across modern browsers without heavy JavaScript libraries?
column2: scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: <thumb> <track>; and ::-webkit-scrollbar pseudo-elements.

column1: Why should scroll-snap-type be removed or reset at desktop breakpoints (e.g., min-width: 768px)?
column2: To restore standard multi-column 2D grid wrapping and natural vertical page flow on wide screens.

column1: How does @media (min-width: 768px) restore a multi-column CSS grid from a mobile horizontal flex track?
column2: Setting display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(320px, 1fr)); and flex: initial; on children.

column1: Why should JavaScript category filtering reset horizontal scroll on a scroll-snap container?
column2: To ensure filtered items are viewed starting from the first card rather than an arbitrary mid-rail scroll offset.

column1: What is the defensive JavaScript pattern to smoothly reset element scroll position across all environments?
column2: if (typeof el.scrollTo === 'function') { el.scrollTo({ left: 0, behavior: 'smooth' }); } else { el.scrollLeft = 0; }

column1: What CSS pseudo-element targets the draggable handle of a scrollbar in Chromium/WebKit engines?
column2: ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb

column1: What accessibility attribute hides visual swipe hints from screen readers when they are purely decorative?
column2: aria-hidden="true"

column1: Why does reducing vertical mobile scroll depth by horizontalizing sections improve user engagement?
column2: It eliminates vertical thumb fatigue, shortens the total page height, and allows users to explore categories in parallel.

column1: What CSS property defines the safe snapping boundary inside a scroll container with fixed padding?
column2: scroll-padding: 0 16px; (or scroll-padding-inline: 16px;)

column1: Why is flex: 0 0 <width> preferred over width: <width> inside horizontal flex scroll containers?
column2: flex-shrink: 0 prevents flexbox from shrinking child cards when total card width exceeds the parent container width.

column1: How does overflow-y: hidden paired with overflow-x: auto benefit mobile horizontal touch tracks?
column2: It isolates horizontal swipe gestures and prevents vertical scroll jitter within the track container.

column1: What is the minimum recommended touch target size according to WCAG 2.1 AA guidelines?
column2: 44px by 44px (or 48px by 48px in Google Material Design guidelines)

column1: Why should buttons inside a horizontal swipe track prevent unwanted navigation during drag gestures?
column2: To avoid accidental clicks when the user intends to swipe/scroll through the card carousel.

column1: How does @keyframes pulseSwipe provide non-intrusive micro-interaction feedback?
column2: It gently pulses opacity (e.g. 0.85 to 1.0) and subtle scale to catch the user's eye without obstructing content.

column1: Why should mobile swipe hint badges be hidden on desktop viewports via media queries?
column2: Desktop users navigate via mouse wheel / scrollbar; mobile swipe prompts are irrelevant and clutter desktop layouts.

column1: What CSS property prevents text selection while dragging or swiping on mobile touch surfaces?
column2: user-select: none; (-webkit-user-select: none;)

column1: How does CSS scroll-snap improve performance over JavaScript-based touch carousel libraries?
column2: CSS scroll-snap runs entirely on the browser's compositor thread, achieving 60/120fps smooth scrolling without main thread overhead.

column1: What browser metric is preserved at 0 by using CSS scroll-snap instead of dynamic JavaScript DOM carousel rewrites?
column2: Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS = 0) and Total Blocking Time (TBT = 0ms).
